主要内容: Subaru of America, Inc. announced the debut of the re-styled 2013 Subaru Legacy at the 2012 New York International Auto Show. The 2013 Legacy features a new 2.5-liter four-cylinder powertrain with 173 horsepower and 174 lb.-ft. of torque, offering improved fuel efficiency and performance. It also includes the EyeSight driver-assist system with Pre-Collision Braking, Lane Departure Warning, and Adaptive Cruise Control. The 2.5i model with Lineartronic CVT is projected to achieve 24 mpg city/32 mpg highway/27 mpg combined, surpassing the 2012 model's 23/31/26 mpg. The 3.6R model retains a 256-horsepower 3.6-liter engine with a five-speed automatic transmission. The vehicle maintains Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive, making it the most fuel-efficient midsize all-wheel drive sedan in America. The redesign includes a sportier front styling and enhanced chassis for smoother handling and comfort.
